newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks jump in morning, red chips soar.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks jump in morning, red chips soar.

text.p: Hong Kong's blue chips jumped in Monday morning trade, as they drew strength from new records on Wall Street and continued a recovery from a slide last week, but red chips were the focus with the launch of a new index.
The Hang Seng Index was up 164.94 points, or 1.17 percent, at 14,277.49.
The new Hang Seng China-Affiliated Corporations index, which was launched on Monday, gained 155.58 points, or 5.82 percent, to 2,828.39.
Overall market turnover was HK$5.12 billion after the first hour of trade.

"The market is boosted by Wall Street but it is pretty much a red-chip day today," said Geoff Galbraith, institutional sales trader at NAVA SC Securities. "This red chip index -- all these stocks are being played at the moment," he said.
Brokers said the Dow industrials' sixth consecutive record closing high on Friday was boosting sentiment in the local market, helping the Hang Seng Index recover from a 542.58 point drop last week.
"The market is being led by the futures, encouraged by the performance of the U.S. market," added Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas.
June Hang Seng Index futures rose 120 points to 14,260.

However, property stocks underperformed the market, with the property sub-index up 130.46 points, or 0.55 percent, at 23,704 as investors continued to show concern about possible government measures to curb spiralling property prices.
Utilities were the strongest performers among the blue chips with Hongkong Electric up HK$1.15 at HK$30.60, Hongkong and China Gas up HK$0.45 at HK$14.80 and Hongkong Telecom up HK$0.40 to HK$16.75.
Among the red chips, Shanghai Industrial rose HK$2.20 to HK$43.40, China Merchants gained HK$1.20 to HK$16.45 and China Resources surged HK$1.50 to HK$27.70.
All three stocks are constituents of HSI Services Ltd's 32 company Hang Seng China-Affiliated Corporations Index.
"Red chips are outshining the market since today is the start of trade of the red chip index," said Mak.
